inputs.label: Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox disc image
inputs.help: Your own disc image of the original Xbox Halo: Combat Evolved, as .iso or .xiso. The Steam MCC and Anniversary PC versions do not work.

steps.text: Open Halo CE VR from Library > Unknown Sources. Choose the disc image in Download with the file picker. The game extracts the maps into its own storage.

notes: The guide also allows pushing an extracted maps folder (ui.map, bloodgulch.map) to /sdcard/Documents/HaloCE/maps/, which is the payload targetPath; this recipe uses the in-app ISO import instead, so the files end up in Android/data/com.halo.decomp.vr/files. freeSpaceMB is the guide's 1.8 GB for extracted maps, cache and sound, not counting the image itself. Releases also carry HaloCE-Android-*.apk, which the asset pattern avoids.
